versions.subject: Updated search for abnormally high cloud instances. Including verifying that enough data is there
versions.detection: | tstats earliest(_time) as longEnough from datamodel=Change where All_Changes.All_Changes.object_category=instance | eval filter="*" | eval enough_data=if(longEnough < relative_time(now(), "-14d"), 1, 0) | table filter, enough_data | outputlookup cloud_instances_enough_data
